C_general_recurrence_or_dynamics.reason: No exact linear/divisibility recurrence for N_{q,T}(n) is locked. Arithmetic-dynamical primitive-divisor theorems for degree >=2 rational-map iteration do not match the degree-1 group translation Q |-> Q+P on E_q.

D_replacement.reason: The obstruction itself is a square condition on a rational function over seven fixed elliptic curves. The exact algebraic reduction produces seven fixed genus-5 double-cover/fiber-product curves, so direct rational-point exclusion attacks the same universal population and simultaneously avoids the rank-one torsion-translate and rank-two primitive-ordering problems.

route_selection.why_before_primitive_divisors: It attacks the exact square obstruction directly, handles rank one and rank two uniformly, and avoids proving the strictly stronger fresh-prime plus odd-valuation assertions unless the direct rational-point route fails.
